system.description:
The Song of the Sword infuses the blade with a dread and vengeful power. The Sword Singer may only sing one blessing at a time, but he may bless any sword in his presence.

Obstacle: See Description. The singer chooses the blade blessing to be sung before rolling: Morn Blade, (+1 weapon speed), Ob 1. Singing Blade (open-ended sword dice), Ob 2; Preternatural Balance (+1D), Ob 3; Crushing Edge (+1 VA), Ob 4; Sword of Might (+1 Power), Ob 5; Blinding Blade (+3 weapon speed), Ob 6; Blood Drinker (reduce Add by 1), Ob 7; Sun Blade (increase weapon length to “longest”), Ob 8. All blessings also make the weapon a “spirit blade” which may affect creatures with the Spirit Nature trait.

Actions: Obstacle x 1

Elven spell song: counts as a sorcerous skill for practice and learning; tests are always open-ended (natural magic); no tools, no FoRKs; causes wonderment. Root is Will unless otherwise noted.

Restrictions: Elves only

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 150
